solutions.title: Recursive include/skip search
solutions.strategy: At each text character, either use it if it matches the current target character or skip it.

timeComplexity.explanation: In the worst matching-heavy case, the recursion can branch over many text positions.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Recursive calls can grow with the text length.

solutions.title: Two pointers
solutions.strategy: Advance the candidate pointer only when the current text character matches.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each string is scanned left to right at most once.
